what: 168Railway: the corridor lines of the `indo` template. Each family is one line along the path a GAPEKA 2026 train takes from `from` to `to` (through `via`). An intercity train whose stations (stops and pass-throughs) lie at least `share` along a family's path rides that family (the one it shares most with), whatever its name or end: its trains count toward the family's frequency and it is cut to the family's path. The line stops where at least `stop_share` of its trains stop. A train in no family keeps its own line by its end cities (gapeka_indo.py). The game has no skip-stop trips within a line, so a line has one stopping pattern. KRL is not grouped here.
